advice: Abstain. The supplied evidence does not support a new bounded FP32 panel layout with a clearly specified reuse benefit. The sixteen-call panel32 layout is already tested and showed mixed paired changes (−3.1%, +0.5%, +2.2%); it was not promoted. A different 32-row A-panel design would require a new traversal and compute path whose implementation is not established by the supplied evidence.
risks: No new experiment is proposed. The existing scores do not establish a speedup or its cause. Do not repeat the tested panel32 wrapper as a distinct experiment.
